questions.stem: Select every statement that is true for PostgreSQL when amount can be NULL.

questions.stem: Paid orders have amounts 1000 and NULL. In PostgreSQL, what is SUM(amount)?

| Pens | 100 | 2500 | 5 |

| Cards | 50 | 1500 | 0 |

| Pens | 100 | 2500 | 5 |
